steps.spokenPrompt: First, wash your hands with soap and water, where the camera can see them.
steps.successCriteria: Both hands are being rubbed together under running water or with soap lather.

steps.spokenPrompt: Pick up the pen and read the name on the label out loud.
steps.successCriteria: The pen is held up near the face with its label toward the person.

steps.spokenPrompt: Hold the pen up to the camera and check the date on the label. Say "checked" when you have looked.
steps.successCriteria: The pen is held up close to the camera with the label facing the camera.

steps.instruction: Clean your thigh with the alcohol swab
steps.spokenPrompt: Wipe the front of your thigh with the alcohol swab. Let it dry.
steps.successCriteria: A small white swab or wipe is being rubbed on the front of the thigh.

steps.instruction: Pull the cap off the pen
steps.spokenPrompt: Pull the cap straight off the pen. Don't touch the tip.
steps.successCriteria: One hand holds the pen body while the other pulls the cap off the end.

steps.instruction: Place the pen on your thigh at a right angle
steps.spokenPrompt: Place the tip of the pen flat against your thigh, straight up and down.
steps.successCriteria: The pen tip touches the front of the thigh with the pen held upright, about 90 degrees to the skin.

steps.spokenPrompt: Press the pen down firmly and hold it there. I'll count the time for you.
steps.successCriteria: The pen is pressed upright against the thigh and held still.

steps.spokenPrompt: Now lift the pen straight up and away from your thigh.
steps.successCriteria: The pen is lifted away from the thigh and no longer touching the skin.

steps.instruction: Put the pen in the sharps container
steps.spokenPrompt: Put the used pen in your sharps container.
steps.successCriteria: The pen is being placed into a box or container.
